steps.text: Pick factions with total Reach of at least {n}
steps.note: Marquise 10, Hundreds 9, Keepers 8, Duchy 8, Lilypad 7, Eyrie 7, Vagabond 5 (second 2), Riverfolk 5, Knaves 4, Twilight 4, Alliance 3, Corvid 3, Lizard 2

steps.text: Assign factions; random starting player and seating; each takes their faction board and pieces
Bots: set up each bot as described in the Law of Rootbotics
Choose a map; variant maps (Winter, Mountain, Lake): follow its setup, then shuffle the 12 suit markers facedown onto the clearings
A ruin on each of the 4 "R" slots
Item supply at the top of the map: 2 boots, 2 bags, 1 crossbow, 1 hammer, 2 swords, 2 tea, 2 coins
Two battle dice by the map; hand out overview cards as desired
Optionally swap the shared deck for the Exiles and Partisans (or Squires and Disciples) deck
Random seating order and first player
Optional landmarks: deal 1-2, the last player(s) in turn order set them up
Optional hirelings: deal 3 and demote {n} at random; set them up counterclockwise from the last player; markers on 4, 8 and 12 of the score track
steps.note: Box any faction whose hireling is in play

steps.text: Draw {n} cards each (you keep 3 later)
Setup-card draft: 1 militant card to the pool, then 1 card per player from the rest; choose counterclockwise from the last player and set up immediately
steps.note: 2 players: no insurgent cards. A Vagabond card gets a random character; Knaves get 4 Captain cards

steps.text: Keep 3 cards, put 2 facedown on the deck, then shuffle the deck
Score markers on 0
Remove the 4 dominance cards
Shuffle the shared deck; each player draws {n}
Set up factions in setup order (A, B, C...) following each faction board's back
Set up factions in setup order (A, B, C...) following each faction board's back
First to 30 victory points wins
2 players: best played as two games, swapping factions and adding scores
Only use the river when the Riverfolk Company is in play
The starting player takes their Birdsong, Daylight and Evening
